newsitem.title: USA: GTECH sole bidder for Louisiana lottery.
newsitem.headline: GTECH sole bidder for Louisiana lottery.

text.p: GTECH Holdings Corp said on Thursday that the company is the sole responsive bidder to Louisiana's On-Line Lottery Procurement.
Louisiana is expected to make a decision regarding a contract next month, GTECH said.
In Texas, the state's Lottery Commission continues to say that it will rebid the contract currently held by GTECH on or before June 30, 1997, the company said.
GTECH said that it had received a five year extension on this contract last year and it is pursuing its options to ensure that the contract extension is upheld.
GTECH also said it has received contract extensions in Ohio and Chile.
